sourceScope.enumerationMeaning: Complete only as a frozen capture of the returned DeFiLlama roster; not asserted complete for the seven-chain DeFi market. Entire 8,476-row API roster retained before ranking.
notCaptured: complete 90-day protocol-family-compatible activity by target chain
complete lending, yield/vault, staking/restaking, bridge and perpetual category usage metrics

classificationRules.activityRequirement: Only affirmative, product- and chain-attributed, category-compatible positive metric dated within 90 days may establish observed activity during the 90-day interval.
classificationRules.thirtyDayHandling: Report observed 30-day metrics separately. Positive 30-day observation is evidence activity occurred within the 90-day window but is not a 90-day total or separate 90-day measurement.
classificationRules.zeroHandling: A numeric zero is retained as a numeric observation; it never establishes inactivity alone unless category, chain, product attribution and completeness of the 90-day observation are demonstrated.
classificationRules.missingHandling: Missing metrics, chain attribution, product identity, category compatibility, or source response are UNKNOWN and retained conservatively. Failure is never converted to zero.
classificationRules.tvlHandling: USD 1,000,000 TVL is a prioritization threshold only; it is neither activity evidence nor a denominator exclusion.
classificationRules.lineageHandling: Preserve DeFiLlama source IDs, slugs, parentProtocol and linkedProtocols. Do not merge parents, child products, aliases or versions without verified canonical identity evidence.
classificationRules.coverageClaim: No universal 90% claim unless market enumeration and identity/category attribution are independently established complete. Workflow completeness is a separate offline report.

frozenRoster.sourceRecords: All source roster rows with identifiers and lineage are preserved in market-snapshot.json protocolUniverse; source record counts are not a count of unique canonical products.

active90Day.reason: No captured metric row supplies a uniform compatible 90-day observation plus verified canonical product and target-chain attribution.

observedInactive90Day.meaning: None classified; this does not mean there are zero inactive products.

unresolvedConservativeDenominator.meaning: All 8,476 frozen roster rows remain unclassified for coverage until canonical product, target-chain, category, and affirmative 90-day evidence are reconciled; counts above are field-level observations and not disjoint products.

metricEvidencePolicy.metricRowSource: market-snapshot.json observedMetricRows; each row keeps source ID, chain, source category, 30-day value (including null or numeric zero), 7-day and 24-hour values, and comparison value where returned.
metricEvidencePolicy.fees: Fees are not treated as literal user transaction counts or universal usage; category-specific methodology must be validated before using as affirmative activity evidence.
metricEvidencePolicy.chainTVL: The roster may report aggregate TVL and chain list. Aggregate Multi-Chain TVL is not attributed to a target chain.
metricEvidencePolicy.responseErrors: Monad options HTTP 500 is unavailable/unknown; see market-snapshot.json fetchErrors.
